title: #1 Robb Gravett, Shell Team Trakstar Ford Sierra Sapphire, BTCC 1991
note: Left side measured on the Getty / LAT photo 'Silverstone 14 July 1991, Robb Gravett' (near side-on, nose left; the model outline was traced from it, so positions read straight off it); colours and the rear quarter from the colour photo Super Touring Register 3243 (Brands Hatch), warped onto the model; checked against the TV graphic drawings and the season review frames. Red upper body, yellow lower body and boot spoiler, the bonnet pecten wrapping onto the front wing, big pecten across the door shut line, red Shell on the yellow, sponsor sticker list on the C-pillar. Wheels: white 5-spoke, from the pit-lane photo (Super Touring Register 2567, car standing). Uncertain: 'We race / You win' on the rear quarter shows in the Brands Hatch photo and the TV frames but not in the Silverstone July photos, drawn as in most references; the C-pillar sticker names are unreadable and drawn as yellow bars; the thin orange edge on the red/yellow line is approximate. Logos (2026-11-16): the door pecten (inside the drawn yellow edge), the red Shell on the doors, the Ford oval and the rear YOKOHAMA with its orange-red Y chevron are now the real logos; the front bumper YOKOHAMA stays text (the photos show the word without the chevron and there is no word-only file); the bonnet pecten wrapping onto the wing stays drawn (a cut, bent view of the bonnet decal a flat logo cannot show), and Gemini, We race / You win (Trakstar) and the C-pillar sticker list stay text or bars (no logo exists, most lines unreadable). 2026-11-16: front wing now shows the lower half of the big bonnet pecten (yellow with red edge, wrapping onto the wing) as on STR 3243 and Getty LAT 2201201111, replacing the zigzag stand-in; Sapphire outline cleaned (round arches, single panel lines). 2026-11-16: C-pillar sticker list re-checked on the closest left-side view, the paddock rear 3/4 photo Super Touring Register 3381 (22 September 1991): seven yellow rows, each only 3 to 4 pixels high, still unreadable; the Getty LAT Donington fronts (2201200788, 2201201064) and the supertouring.co.uk 'gravett_91c' (right side, 230 px) do not show them either. Kept as yellow bars. 2026-11-16: moved onto the new hand-traced Sapphire outline (true side-on Cosworth photo, race wheels, deeper air dam, boot wing) by landmarks and re-checked against the race photos.
wheel_note: Rim design re-checked on STR 2567 (pit lane): zoomed wheel, spoke count, window shape and sweep.
